task.title: Deleting a robot account by using the UI
task.shortdesc: To remove a robot account that you no longer need, you can delete it by using the Red Hat Quay UI.

step.cmd: Log into your Red Hat Quay registry:
Click the name of the Organization that has the robot account.
Check the box of the robot account to be deleted.
Type confirm into the textbox, then click Delete.
